jobs.title: Finance Associate
jobs.description: Finance Associate Edinburgh | Full-time Wordsmith Legal touches everything that matters in a business: every deal, every hire, every launch, every risk. Sales runs on Salesforce. Engineering runs on GitHub. In-house legal runs on inboxes, chat threads and tools that weren’t built for it. Wordsmith is changing that. We’re building the platform in-house legal runs on. Requests from across the business come in through one front door. AI agents handle the routine work. Lawyers stay in control where judgment matters. Legal finally gets to triage by risk, not by whoever shouted loudest. We’re built for in-house teams, not law firms. Our customers want to spend less on outside counsel, not more, and we’re on their side of that equation. More than 500 companies run on Wordsmith, including Financial Times, Canva, Trip.com, Revolut, Adyen, Trustpilot, and Sage. We’ve raised $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, and we’re growing fast. This role is based in our office in Edinburgh. Why this role is different You won’t be joining a big, process-heavy finance function. You’ll be one of the founding Finance hires, working on a brand new, AI-native ERP system (Rillet) with the freedom to actually improve how things are done — not just keep the lights on. If you want real exposure to the business, a seat close to the founders and leadership team, and the chance to shape processes rather than inherit them, this is that seat. The Role As Finance Assistant, you’ll own the day-to-day mechanics that keep Wordsmith’s finances running — cash, invoicing, collections, payables and expenses — and you’ll have the tools and the licence to automate as much of it as possible. jobs.title: Financial Reporting Consolidation Team Lead
jobs.description: The Financial Reporting Consolidation Team Lead is responsible for overseeing the group-wide financial consolidation process, ensuring accurate and timely consolidated financial statements in compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), and company policies. The role leads intercompany eliminations, currency translations, minority interest calculations, and statutory, regulatory, and management reporting, while coordinating group audit requirements to ensure the integrity and accuracy of consolidated financial records. What You'll Do: Oversee the end-to-end monthly, quarterly, and annual financial consolidation process, prepare complete sets of consolidated financial statements, and execute consolidation activities (including transport of schedules to server, intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translations, and equity/non-controlling interest adjustments) Ensure group-wide accounting records, subsidiary submissions, and consolidated financial data are complete, accurate, and compliant with company policies, applicable accounting standards (IFRS/GAAP), and regulatory/statutory requirements. Coordinate and support internal and external group audit activities by ensuring timely responses to audit inquiries and providing consolidated schedules, elimination reconciliations, and supporting documents. Identify opportunities to streamline the close and consolidation timeline, enhance data integrity across entities, and lead the implementation of system and process efficiency initiatives. Lead the training, coaching, and mentoring of Consolidation and Financial Reporting Analysts.

jobs.title: Accounting Operations Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Über Buena Buena baut die Technologie, auf der die Immobilienbranche läuft. Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich, vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. Mit über 90.000 verwalteten Einheiten und mehr als 30 übernommenen Hausverwaltungen sind wir in den letzten drei Jahren zu Deutschlands zweitgrößtem Immobilienverwalter geworden. Über die Rolle Jeden Monat derselbe Schreibtisch, dieselben Konten, derselbe Bestand. Und wenn dich dein nächster Buchhaltungsjob quer durch Deutschland führt? Du bist Buena vor Ort. Du reist zu unseren bestehenden Hausverwaltungen und machst aus jeder einen Buena-Betrieb. Bei jedem Einsatz lernst du eine andere Stadt, ein neues Team und einen neuen Bestand kennen. Du steigst direkt in die WEG-Buchhaltung ein, buchst selbst in unserer KI-nativen Buena App und zeigst dem Team anhand seiner eigenen Fälle, wie es darin bucht und abrechnet.
